# Log START when build begins
~/.oss/hooks/oss-log.sh write build "build:START - Executing TDD plan with N tasks"

# Log MILESTONE for each TDD phase per task
~/.oss/hooks/oss-log.sh milestone build red "Task 1 RED: should validate email format"
~/.oss/hooks/oss-log.sh milestone build green "Task 1 GREEN: tests passing"
~/.oss/hooks/oss-log.sh milestone build refactor "Task 1 REFACTOR: extracted regex constant"
~/.oss/hooks/oss-log.sh milestone build complete "Task 1 COMPLETE"

# Log AGENT_SPAWN when delegating to specialists
~/.oss/hooks/oss-log.sh agent build react-specialist "UserProfile component"

# Log COMPLETE when all tasks done
~/.oss/hooks/oss-log.sh write build "build:COMPLETE - All N tasks complete (M/M tests passing)"
~/.oss/hooks/oss-log.sh write build "build:FAILED - Task 3 tests failing after 3 attempts"

git add test/validation.test.ts
git commit -m "test: add email validation test (RED)" && git push

git add src/validation.ts test/validation.test.ts
git commit -m "feat: implement email validation (GREEN)" && git push

git add src/validation.ts
git commit -m "refactor: extract email regex to constant" && git push
~/.oss/hooks/oss-log.sh write build "[WARN] oss:ui-review not available — skipping UI review. Update your plugin."

# 1. Detect start command from package.json scripts
DEV_CMD=$(node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.scripts.dev || p.scripts.start || 'npx next dev')")

# 2. Start in background
$DEV_CMD &
DEV_PID=$!

# 3. Wait for ready (poll health endpoint)
for i in {1..30}; do
  curl -s http://localhost:3000 > /dev/null && break
  sleep 1
done

# 4. Run visual feedback loop via Playwright MCP (browser_snapshot)
# ... snapshot, compare, fix, repeat ...

# 5. Cleanup - kill dev server when done
kill $DEV_PID

# 1. Boot simulator
xcrun simctl boot "iPhone 16 Pro" 2>/dev/null || true

# 2. Build and install
xcodebuild -scheme MyApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' build
xcrun simctl install booted ./build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/MyApp.app

# 3. Launch app
xcrun simctl launch booted com.example.MyApp
sleep 3

# 4. Screenshot
xcrun simctl io booted screenshot /tmp/visual-feedback-snapshot.png

# 5. Cleanup
xcrun simctl shutdown booted

# 1. Get available devices
flutter devices

# 2. Run on simulator/emulator
flutter run -d <device_id> &
FLUTTER_PID=$!
sleep 10

# 3. Screenshot
flutter screenshot --out=/tmp/visual-feedback-snapshot.png

# 4. Cleanup
kill $FLUTTER_PID

# 1. Start emulator (or use already running)
emulator -avd Pixel_7_API_34 -no-window &
adb wait-for-device

# 2. Build and install
./gradlew installDebug

# 3. Launch
adb shell am start -n com.example.myapp/.MainActivity
sleep 3

# 4. Screenshot
adb exec-out screencap -p > /tmp/visual-feedback-snapshot.png

# 5. Cleanup
adb emu kill
